policy: MuslimSim may install only a local INF package that is listed here, matches its recorded SHA-256, and has a valid Authenticode signature from an allowed signer. No web download and no unsigned driver install.

windows-native.title: Windows native class driver
windows-native.expected: Built into/supplied by Windows; no MuslimSim driver package required.

wch-ch34x.title: WCH CH340/CH341 USB serial
wch-ch34x.expected: Windows/WCH signed USB-serial driver. A reviewed signed INF may be embedded in a later MuslimSim release.

pu-composite.title: PU composite USB/HID/serial
pu-composite.expected: Windows or reviewed signed device driver exposing the PU serial/HID interfaces. No cockpit application is required.
